name: STAND: Sins of the Immortals
description:
About This Game

STAND: Sins of the Immortals is a brutal hack and slash action game set in a corrupted realm overrun by darkness. Choose one of three cursed immortals: Tank, Archer, or Samurai, and carve your path through relentless waves of enemies. Fight solo, supported by your two fixed companions, each with their own combat style and abilities, delivering the feel of a full team even when playing alone. Online co-op for up to 3 players is coming soon, bringing the chaos to a new level as you team up with friends.

Battle across ruined lands in missions built around tight, aggressive combat, infused with blood, steel, and rhythm. Adapt on the fly by unlocking new skills during each run, shifting your strategy mid battle to survive overwhelming odds and escalate your power.

Key Features:

  • Three Fixed Classes, Endless Carnage: Choose from three distinct classes – the stalwart Tank, the deadly Archer, or the swift Samurai – each with unique weapons and playstyles. Hack, slash, and shoot through foes with fluid, combo-driven combat tailored to your class.

  • Solo Play or 3 Player Co-op (Coming Soon): Begin your journey alone with your two companions or join forces with up to two friends in full online co-op once multiplayer is added.

  • Relentless Horde Battles: Face waves of enemies ranging from hordes of lesser fiends to powerful elite monsters. As you advance, encounter ferocious bosses and special enemy variants that will challenge your reflexes and strategy. No two battles are the same, keeping the action fast-paced and unpredictable.

  • Real-Time Upgrades & Builds: Adapt on the fly with a dynamic skill progression system. Earn upgrades in real time during each run, allowing you to unlock new abilities, buffs, and defenses mid-battle. Experiment with powerful skill synergies to create a new build every session and keep the enemy guessing.

  • Immersive Dark Fantasy World: Explore a grim, atmospheric realm scarred by the abuse of immortality. Haunting visuals, foreboding lore, and visceral effects (blood and gore aplenty) create an immersive setting that balances epic scale with a sense of dread.

  • Dynamic Soundtrack: Experience music that adapts to the intensity of combat, shifting tempo and tone to match your performance and enhance every moment of the action.

Ongoing Updates & Expansion: STAND: Sins of the Immortals launches in Early Access and will continuously grow. Expect regular content updates – new modes, enemy types, weapons, and the much-anticipated online co-op mode – all shaped by community feedback. The journey doesn’t end at launch; it’s just beginning.
short_desc: Rise as a cursed immortal bound to an endless war against a relentless horde. Witness every drop of blood and shattered bone in brutal 3D combat with realistic visuals. Unlock new powers through real-time skill upgrades. Whether alone or with allies, only one thing matters—how long can you STAND.
